description: This file is a controller class for managing product reviews within the admin panel of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides functionalities such as listing, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting reviews, along with handling related requests and rendering views.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for handling CRUD operations, listing, and management actions related to product reviews in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the review management page; initializes view with filters, breadcrumbs, and subview data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a simple list of reviews, primarily calls getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for listing reviews with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the review creation/edit form, populating fields if editing an existing review.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of review data, either adding a new review or updating an existing one, with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Adds a background task/reporting task for review rating calculations, requiring modify permission.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected reviews, setting their status to active with permission checks.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected reviews, setting their status to inactive with permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected reviews from the database, with permission validation.
